input: # Zig lexes a whole run of `\\` lines as ONE token and skips the whitespace
# between them, so a blank line inside the run continues the literal.

.{
  .message =
    \\hello, world!

    \\this is a multiline string!
    \\
    \\...

  ,
  .message2 =
    \\this too...sort of.
  ,
}
# A `\xNN` run is a run of BYTES decoded as UTF-8, as it is in Zig; an
# ill-formed sequence is one U+FFFD per maximal subpart in every runtime.
# A `\u{...}` escape may carry leading zeros and names any scalar value,
# so U+D7FF and U+E000 stand either side of the surrogate block that
# A malformed string carries the ENGINE's code for the fault, the same
# code in all three runtimes, so a caller branching on it sees what the
# engine's own string matcher would have said.
